Automobile Sales Executive & Senior Sales Executive Job at HR Leverage Africa




        
    

        
        HR Leverage Africa is a leading Human Resources consulting firm dedicated to providing innovative and practical solutions to businesses across Africa. With a strong presence in several African countries and head quarters located in Lagos, Nigeria, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner for organizations seeking to optimize their human capital and drive business growth.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

Job Position: Automobile Sales Executive & Senior Sales Executive

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Company Overview
     

            
    




	HRLeverage, a leading Pan-African workforce management company with a physical presence in eight African countries, is recruiting on behalf of our client, a reputable player in the automobile industry, for experienced sales professionals.


About the Role


	We’re looking for ambitious and target-driven Sales Executives and Senior Sales Executives with proven experience in the automotive, banking, or real estate industry to drive sales, build lasting client relationships, and exceed business targets.


Key Responsibilities


	Drive vehicle sales and achieve assigned targets.
	Identify and convert new business opportunities.
	Build strong customer relationships and deliver exceptional service.
	Conduct product presentations and negotiate sales.
	Maintain an active sales pipeline and follow up on leads.


Requirements


	HND/Bachelor’s degree in any relevant discipline.
	Proven sales experience in automotive, banking, or real estate.
	Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
	Results-oriented with a passion for sales.


Why Join?


	Competitive salary (Negotiable)
	Attractive commission structure
	Career growth opportunities.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using “Auto mobile Sales Executive” or “Automobile Senior Sales Executive” as the subject of the email.

Mechanical Engineer CIL Job at Sahara Group




        
    

        
        Sahara Group is a leading international energy and infrastructure conglomerate with operations in over 38 countries across Africa, Middle East, Europe and Asia. Spanning three decades, we have broken ground and challenged stereotypes across the global business landscape. The women and men who make up our organization are our strongest levers for growth.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Mechanical Engineer CIL

Job Identification: 609
Job Locations: Abuja and Lagos
Job type: Full-time

Role Accountabilities
     

            
    




	Understand the design drawings and specifications and site requirements in relation to MEP/R systems (Mechanical, Plumbing / Refrigeration) and components.
	Ensure that Mechanical works are undertaken in accordance with the approved procedures/specifications and that construction is made in accordance with the approved construction drawings. 
	Documentation of project activities and monitor/tabulate all Mechanical works. 
	Preparation of accomplishment report/progress report development affecting progress of works such as change orders, field meetings action taken, and verification of details. 
	Aid in planning, coordinating and participate in the conceptual development of a construction project and review its organization, scheduling and implementation. 
	Supervise subcontractors work activities. 
	Mechanical equipment?processes and testing procedures.
	Quality assurance procedures and project QC submissions. 
	Review and follow all safety requirements 
	Co?ordinate with consultants, sub?contractors, vendors, construction team 
	Experience of liaising with local regulations and authorities.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
	Minimum experience of 5 years with at least 2 years of site experience.
	Good command of English, verbal and written.
	Experience in Highrise constructions
	AutoCAD / Revit
	Multi -project management
	Experience in multiple ME works: generators, Panels, Pumps, Plumbing, Power Systems, AC-Systems, Lifts.

Built on strong ethical values and guided by Catholic healthcare principles, we combine clinical excellence with genuine empathy to ensure the best outcomes for every patient.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Medical Laboratory Scientist&nbsp;

Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	St. Dominic Catholic Hospital is seeking a highly competent, detail-oriented, and motivated Medical Laboratory Scientist with specialization in Microbiology to join its diagnostic services team.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for performing microbiological investigations, identifying infectious agents, ensuring accurate laboratory diagnosis, and supporting clinicians in patient management through timely and reliable laboratory results.
	The ideal candidate must possess strong technical expertise in microbiology, excellent analytical skills, and a commitment to maintaining high standards of laboratory practice and patient care.


Key Responsibilities


	Perform microbiological analyses including bacteriology, virology, mycology, and parasitology investigations.
	Collect, receive, process, culture, and analyze clinical specimens in accordance with standard laboratory procedures.
	Conduct microscopy, culture, sensitivity testing, and organism identification procedures.
	Perform antimicrobial susceptibility testing and provide accurate interpretation of results.
	Ensure strict compliance with aseptic techniques and biosafety standards.
	Maintain quality control and quality assurance procedures within the laboratory.
	Prepare, label, and maintain culture media, reagents, and laboratory consumables.
	Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot microbiology laboratory equipment.
	Document and report laboratory findings accurately and promptly.
	Collaborate with clinicians and other healthcare professionals in patient diagnosis and management.
	Monitor infection trends and support infection prevention and control initiatives within the hospital.
	Ensure proper handling, storage, and disposal of infectious materials and laboratory waste.
	Participate in laboratory audits, accreditation activities, and continuous quality improvement programs.


Education and Professional Requirements


	Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Science (BMLS) with specialization or strong background in Microbiology.
	Registration with the Medical Laboratory Science Council of Nigeria (MLSCN).
	Possession of a valid practicing license.


Experience:


	2-5 years of post-qualification experience in a microbiology laboratory is preferred.
	Experience in a hospital or diagnostic laboratory setting is an added advantage.


Other Requirements:


	Strong commitment to quality laboratory practice and patient safety.
	Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism at all times.
	Willingness to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays when necessary.


Required Skills and Competencies:


	Strong knowledge of bacteriology, virology, mycology, and parasitology.
	Proficiency in aseptic techniques and biosafety practices.
	Ability to interpret microbiological results accurately and effectively.
	Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
	Good documentation and report-writing skills.
	Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
	Attention to detail and high level of accuracy.
	Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines.
	Good teamwork and collaboration skills.
	Proficiency in the use of laboratory information systems and basic computer applications.


Remuneration


	Salary: N150,000 - N350,000 monthly.
	Attractive and competitive salary package.
	Opportunities for professional development and continuous training.
	Supportive and conducive working environment.

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Internal Control Executive",
  "description": "Stretch-it Concepts - We are a human resource outsourcing solutions company, bureau of&nbsp;recruitment, performance&nbsp;management and training and development company situated in Lagos, Nigeria.&nbsp;&nbsp;

We are&nbsp;&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Internal Control Executive

Job Location: Lekki Phase 1, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Business Unit / Dept: Internal Control
Report to: Head, Internal Control
Supervises: Internal Control Officer

Job Summary


	The Internal Control Officer is saddled with the responsibility of reviewing all internal processes, systems, and policies and also making recommendations to management to ensure observed risk to the business is minimized with a view to delivering improvements.


Key Responsibilities


	To plan, organize, and carry out the internal controls function including the preparation of risk-based annual audit plan and business standard operating procedures/policies.
	Evaluate compliance with existing policies and procedures, identifying and proposing modifications as needed.
